segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi, yeah, this is Dana with Northlake Foods. I'm calling about invoice 48291 for our June renewal. There's a $640 onboarding services line on there, and we didn't request or use anything like that this month.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks, Dana. Let me pull that up in the billing tool. Can I confirm the account email is billing@northlakefoods.com?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. The invoice came to that shared inbox yesterday, due July 15.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay, I have it. I see your standard 38 seats at $29 each and the support plan, and then that services line you mentioned. Give me just a second to check the notes in the ticketing system.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, so I found the issue. That line was tied to a setup request for a different Northlake account in the admin console. It should not have been added to yours.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, good. We just need the corrected copy before our AP run on Friday.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Understood. I'm removing that charge now and generating a revised invoice. The new total will be $1,302.00, and you'll get the PDF by email in about five minutes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Same invoice number or a new one?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Same invoice number with a revision date of July 3. I'll also add a note on the account so it doesn't get re-applied next cycle.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, thanks for the quick help.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No problem. Your reference is ticket 317844 if you need to follow up.
